# Asset Side — Full Content Reference for LLMs

> Asset Side is the independent marketing consultancy of Archit Aggarwal, a growth and PR partner for luxury, couture, and premium D2C brands. The practice pairs performance marketing with brand prestige, working with a strictly limited client roster so every strategy is built from scratch. Core belief: executing performance marketing without a foundation of brand prestige is a race to the bottom; true luxury doesn't shout, it speaks quietly, confidently, and strictly to the right rooms.

## About

Archit Aggarwal founded Asset Side to give premium labels a single senior partner across paid media, PR, positioning, events, and retail expansion. The name reflects the philosophy: marketing should build brand equity (the asset side of the balance sheet), not just buy attention.

Key positioning principles:
- Creating art, not just inventory: luxury ROI metrics differ from mass-market metrics.
- Affection over attention: saves, shares, DMs, and brand search volume outrank likes and reach.
- Pricing power as the ultimate metric: a brand with cultural authority raises prices without pushback.
- PR and performance marketing run on the same calendar and creative direction.

## Services (11)

1. Performance Marketing — full-funnel Google Ads and Meta Ads built around CAC and ROAS; audience segmentation, creative testing, attribution, conversion rate optimization. Portfolio ROAS improvements from 2.4x to 3.9x.
2. Brand Positioning & GTM Strategy — brand audits, positioning workshops, go-to-market plans for new products, markets, or categories, including a 12-month India entry strategy for a US fragrance label.
3. D2C & WhatsApp-First Commerce — click-to-WhatsApp campaigns, structured conversation flows, retargeting, and retention systems; 2.1x order volume growth for a western wear label.
4. Growth & Lead Generation Systems — multi-channel lead generation, HubSpot/MS Dynamics CRM setup, Zapier automation, cost-per-SQL reduction; scaled one business from 30 to 900+ qualified leads per month.
5. SEO & Website Optimization — technical audits (SEMRush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), Core Web Vitals, local SEO and Google Business Profile for multi-outlet businesses including Pizza Hut, Royal Enfield, and Kaya Skin Clinic.
6. Marketing Analytics & Reporting — GA4 setup, Looker Studio and Power BI dashboards, cross-channel attribution reconciliation.
7. PR — Tier-A editorial placements, celebrity and stylist association, founder features, inter-brand collaborations, planned alongside paid campaigns.
8. Events — exhibition and event management, attendee and exhibitor lead generation, ticketing and check-in experience, post-event retargeting; raised net SQL rate from 25% to 54% for a wedding exhibition business.
9. MBO Placements — multi-brand outlet strategy and outreach across Pernia's Pop-Up Shop, Tata CLiQ Luxury, Ensemble (domestic) and Aashni+Co (international), with ongoing partner management.
10. Social Media Marketing — content calendars, platform-specific strategy, production, community management, influencer collaborations.
11. Campaign & Brand Shoots — moodboards, creative direction, studio/model/vendor coordination, post-production oversight.

## Case studies (11)

- Adyaaye (jewellery): ROAS improved from 2.4x toward 3.9x through full-funnel paid media.
- Monture (western wear): 2.1x order volume growth via WhatsApp-first commerce with stable AOV.
- Jewellery vertical campaign: PR amplification timed to bridal and festive peaks; SQL rate 25% to 54%, cost per SQL cut 50%.
- Ladli Foundation Trust (NGO): 3.5x overseas donation growth in 6 months, 7 web properties across 3 countries, subscription donation model (₹11/month), 12% MoM organic traffic growth.
- Shasha Gaba (menswear): ₹30L/month MBO placement value secured over a 2-year sustained business development push into menswear.
- Bright Rose, Maharashtra Jewellers, Banjara Trail, and four further engagements detailed at https://assetside.lovable.app/case-studies

## Insights (long-form articles)

Performance Marketing:
- The Comprehensive Guide to Measuring the True ROI of Luxury PR — metrics of affection (saves, shares, DMs, time on site), retail expansion, pricing power.
- How Luxury PR Drives Down Customer Acquisition Costs — PR creates demand that performance marketing captures; editorial placements, celebrity styling, and content lower blended CAC.
- Everyone Says Google Ads Is Dead — a rebuttal and framework for paid search in premium categories.
- Which Social KPIs Actually Predict Revenue — the metrics that correlate with revenue versus vanity metrics.

Brand Strategy:
- Standard PR vs. Boutique & Luxury PR — the three-tier agency breakdown and why luxury partners are defined by ecosystem and cultural authority, not size.
- How to Leverage Firm-Generated Content (FGC) — six steps: grid as digital concierge, founder as authority, craftsmanship content, no-desperation copywriting, educational SEO content, metrics of affection.
- The Architecture of Exclusivity: Private PR Events — five steps covering scarcity strategy, guest curation (70-80 people), venue barters, brand-produced content, and post-event MBO leverage.
- How to Build a Targeted Media Network Without Mass Wire Services — seven steps to bespoke media relationships instead of syndicated wire distribution.
- Beyond the Buzzword: Craftsmanship Without Greenwashing — six steps for authentic craftsmanship communication.
- Boutique vs. Conglomerate PR Agency — trade-offs between scale agencies and specialist firms.

Growth Philosophy:
- Why NGO Fundraising Needs Subscription Thinking — donor lifetime value over one-time conversion; why a 0.9 ROAS on acquisition can be the honest starting point.
